shorts.title: The CIA Stole a Soviet Nuclear Sub 🔍 Case #8
shorts.description:
What if I told you Howard Hughes helped the CIA steal a Soviet submarine, nuclear missiles and all? Project Azorian (1974): the CIA's Hughes Glomar Explorer, sold to the world as Howard Hughes's deep-sea mining ship, lifted part of the sunken Soviet missile submarine K-129 from about 16,500 feet down. It cost about $800 million. Asked about the ship, the CIA would 'neither confirm nor deny', now called a Glomar response.

#meatballinvestigates #coldwar #declassified #weirdhistory #projectazorian
